articles.title: Jungfraubahn Holding (SWX:JFN) Stock May Be 9% Undervalued On Cash Flow
articles.summary: Jungfraubahn Holding has delivered a 105.3% share price gain over the past 5 years, which naturally puts the spotlight on whether the current Swiss franc price is adequately backed by the cash the business can generate. After such a long run, the key issue for anyone looking at Jungfraubahn today is how that market verdict lines up with the value implied by its future cash flows. Over 5 years the stock is up 105.3%.
